Axar Patel to Shai Hope, SIX, and he decides to end it with a six and finish by recording his 2nd T20I hundred. The West Indies have pulled off their highest successful run chase in T20Is. This is also the second quickest hundred for West Indies in this format. Shai Hope is absolutely pumped, does a double first pump and celebrates with his partner at the crease. Full and outside off stump, Hope reached out to loft this over long-off. From 5/2 to hunting down 250 with 9 balls to spare, this is sensational stuff from the West Indies

Rutherford 2/2: [What was the chat during your partnership with Shai Hope?] Honestly, it was just about enjoying it. When I went to him, I said, Listen, let's just try and bat as much balls as we could. I'm naturally a fast scorer. I naturally love to take the game on. So I didn't want to run away from that. So it was important for me to just play my game, and I know that once he is there also, it's even better because I can be as free as I could, and he gonna be there till the end. [On Shai Hope] I don't think there's much words to describe him. He is a phenomenal player. Even I look at him and I'm like, oh, how can you do it so steady so often? And I look at him and he inspires me a lot to work hard. Even when he's in the nets, I try to look at him. I try to take as much information. But I mean, the way he's doing, he needs credit. I don't think he got enough credit for what he's been doing, but Shai is a very, very great player and hopefully he continues for us and keeps getting better.
